prisoners.name: Krystal Martinez-DiPippa
prisoners.description: Krystal Martinez-DiPippa is a Pittsburgh activist prosecuted with her husband, Brian “Peppy” DiPippa, after an April 2023 protest against a University of Pittsburgh event featuring anti-transgender speakers. Federal agents raided their home on May 19, 2023 and detained both for several hours. After a federal indictment, Martinez-DiPippa surrendered on June 30, 2023 and was released the same day while Brian remained in pretrial detention. She later pleaded guilty to obstructing law enforcement during a civil disorder. On January 6, 2025, the court sentenced her to three years of probation, community service, and joint restitution rather than imprisonment.

cases.charges: Conspiracy and obstruction of law enforcement during a civil disorder; the conspiracy count did not result in her guilty plea.
cases.plead: Guilty to obstruction of law enforcement during a civil disorder.
cases.sentence: Three years of probation, community service, and joint restitution; no custodial sentence.
